itens.trecho: Hitch finds clever ways to make us laugh at all of our horrible memories of dates gone wrong while telling an endearing story full of heart and hilarity. Hitch makes complete use of Will Smith’s charm and Kevin Smith’s goofiness in a story reminding us that true love can only be found when we are truly ourselves.
One of my favorite movies of all time again. Love this movie! I love movies that have a storyline that's not common in a lot of movies. Thus is also really hilarious.
